subcategory_text: Data elements can be accessed for deletion.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-12 (Information Management and Retention), MP-6 (Media Sanitization)
implementation_examples: Provide authorised requestors with a documented path to delete data elements across the systems that hold them, including backups and derivatives
Apply retention rules so deletion is the default at end of retention period without requiring a request
Propagate deletion to backups and downstream consumers within their respective lifecycles
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data elements can be deleted on request
Determine whether backup and derivative deletion is included in the deletion path
Determine whether retention rules drive automatic deletion at end of retention
Determine whether deletion is propagated to downstream consumers
